title: Total area of shapes
prompt: The input is a list of shape descriptions, each a pair of a name and a list of integer dimensions. A description is valid when it is "circle" with exactly one dimension r (area 3*r*r), "rect" with exactly two dimensions w and h (area w*h), or "square" with exactly one dimension s (area s*s). Any other description (another name, or the wrong number of dimensions) is invalid. Return pair(total area of the valid shapes, number of invalid descriptions).
